title: MoEE Software Engineering Model Exam 1
source: MODEL1.pdf — MoEE Exit Exam (Dagmawi Abate model)

focusGuide.Operating Systems: Scheduling levels, boot process, memory management, and file systems.
focusGuide.Java / OOP: Inheritance, polymorphism, access modifiers, interfaces, and trace small code outputs.
focusGuide.Data Structures: Trees, queues, hash tables, and time-complexity analysis.
focusGuide.Database: Keys, CASCADE actions, SQL joins, views, and ER participation.
focusGuide.Networking: OSI layers, switches, IPv4, ACLs, and encapsulation.
focusGuide.Web Development: HTML forms, CSS properties, and JavaScript APIs.
focusGuide.Android: Lifecycle, layouts, APK, Dalvik/ART, and UI components.
focusGuide.Software Testing: Coverage types, integration testing, precision/recall, and test principles.
focusGuide.Software Engineering: SDLC, requirements, CASE tools, validation vs verification.
focusGuide.Project Management: Project definition, org structures, affinity diagrams, and Pareto.
focusGuide.AI / ML: Agents, search algorithms, ensemble methods, overfitting, and preprocessing.
focusGuide.Security: CIA triad, digital signatures, and professional ethics.
focusGuide.Software Architecture: Styles, notation, performance tactics, and architectural decisions.
focusGuide.C++: Headers, I/O streams, and control-flow behavior.
focusGuide.General: Review lecture notes for any remaining topics.
